lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Отказ загрузки ресурсов не выглядит пустым списком
value.surface: NGW resource selector asynchronous load and fitted error dialog
value.meaning: A successful empty children response remains empty without error; a failed list request returns structured success/status/server metadata and a human error. HTTP401/403 use login/permission wording, known temporary server trouble uses shared server copy, unknown IO/JSON uses a safe retry message.
value.value_origin: Connection/ResourceGroup.loadChildrenWithResult -> primitive ChildrenLoadResult -> adapter childLoadError -> AsyncTask result -> existing onPostExecute dialog after activity-available check. Old void loadChildren API still delegates and keeps caller compatibility.
value.units: Human-readable localized text; no coordinates, CRS, server-body units or technical status dump.
updates: Existing operation lifecycle decides when a dialog/notification/progress message is delivered. A displayed explanation is separate from remote ACK, durable save or full-project completion.
actions: Read the cause and suggested next action; retry through the existing operation only after the reported condition changes.
conditions: Programmatic adapter/dialog, so widgets list is deliberately empty; no assertion of a resource XML ID.
Connect(false), sorting/cache/subload/partial parsing and existing retry policy are preserved.
Response bodies, account URL and exception strings never become the dialog message.
External-database body text can classify only HTTP422;408 remains generic/connect-timeout, while429/all5xx remain server. Same HTTP retry classification is preserved.
value.saved_state: No new persistent error journal, automatic resend, saved-state migration or server mutation is introduced. Existing local edits/recovery and cancellation ownership remain separate contracts.
expectations: Technical successful[] versus500/503/429 must differ; permission403 must not be maintenance.
Known server body on a nonallowed status must not widen the shared HTTP classifier; child request failure remains visibly distinct from empty success.
unknowns: Connect/auth/capability requests before child-list load retain their separate existing classification; partial-parse cache mutation and actual selector lifecycle/device acceptance remain NOT_RUN.
